title: mentha arvensis var. exigua
intro: Mentha arvensis var. exigua, commonly known as American Wild Mint, is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae and is native to North America. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating digestive issues, relieving stress and anxiety, and combating infections. The therapeutic actions of American Wild Mint include its ability to relax the muscles, ease respiratory issues, and promote digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and menthol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
